items.title: Strategic Initiatives Associate
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE This is a high-visibility role which sits at the border between strategic problem solving and operational execution for a fast-growing iGaming business operating across 10+ international markets. Focused on the continuous improvement of one of the most critical enablers of our growth trajectory, the end-to-end customer journey, this role will sit within the Commercial function, reporting into the Head of Strategic Initiatives with a high level of exposure to the ExCo. Reporting into the Head of Strategic Initiatives, supporting the Strategic Initiatives Snr Manager and Strategic Initiatives Manager, this role will drive forward customer journey strategy development, with a focus on Compliance interactions, identifying, and remediating the most significant gaps. This role aims to expedite the commercial benefits expected from the Compliance Customer Journey programme through high-quality funnel analysis, documentation and insight generation, including the mapping live user flows and funnels, auditing communications, tracking remediation actions and reporting against success metrics across all international markets and brands. The right person will be sharp, driven, with a bias to action, adept in data analysis, presentation and communication at all levels of seniority. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: CUSTOMER JOURNEY MAPPING - Execute detailed mapping and documentation of existing customer journeys across acquisition, onboarding, activation, compliance and retention. - Document and evaluate user journeys, with the support of AI tooling (Claude), flagging pain points and inconsistencies across multiple brands and markets. - Identify lifecycle friction points, customer drop-offs and performance gaps across customer funnels CUSTOMER JOURNEY ANALYSIS - Proactively analyse funnel data, conversion metrics, and player drop-off statistics from Tableau/BI tooling/Mixpanel to identify critical drop-off points in the customer journey - Support the development of journey baselines, KPIs and performance measurement frameworks. - Produce actionable insights to support prioritisation of customer journey improvements. - Conduct routine benchmarking and competitive analysis on competitor onboarding, payment, and engagement journeys. PROGRAMME EXECUTION - Support the Strategic Initiatives Manager and Customer Strategy Manager in establishing customer journey frameworks and baseline analysis. - Propose user communication improvements in line with legal, regulatory, and creative requirements. - Prepare journey maps, presentations and supporting documentation for workshops and stakeholder reviews. - Track actions, milestones and progress across the CCJ programme. OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: - Bachelor’s degree from reputable university or demonstrably relevant apprenticeship experience - Highly curious, driven, ambitious and independent - 2+ years’ experience in an analytical fast-paced and data-driven environment, with exposure to senior stakeholders, e.g. Management Consulting, Tech Start-Up, Banking or equivalent iGaming business - Excellent communication skills—able to influence stakeholders at all levels. - Proficiency in data analysis, excel, powerpoint, with knowledge of business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau). - Experience using customer journey mapping tools such as MixPanel will be beneficial, but not essential. - Strong interest in the betting, games, media, technology, and entertainment industries WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. BENEFITS - Hybrid work policy - 4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply) - Well-being allowance to support your active lifestyle - Private health insurance - Discounts across a range of retailers, gyms, bars & restaurants - We offer an employee assistance program that can provide help and guidance during challenging moments. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role The Claude Platform serves developers and enterprises at scale. The Developer Experience (DevX) team owns the surfaces those developers touch every day: the Console, the docs platform, and our SDKs and CLI. Our job is to make the Platform easy to adopt and trustworthy enough to build critical applications on, to get new model and API capabilities into developers' hands fast and ergonomically, and to build for both humans and the coding agents that increasingly use our docs and SDKs on their behalf. The work splits into two workstreams, covered below, and we need your help across both. What you'll do DevX Core: You'll help drive technical direction for the Console and docs platform — the surfaces every developer on the Claude Platform uses — working with product and design from problem definition through launch. The Console is also the front door for tens of internal teams shipping their own features onto it, so you'll set the platform patterns and standards they build against. SDKs: You'll own the SDKs across seven languages plus our CLI — the first thing most developers (and most coding agents) touch when they integrate Claude. You'll partner with API teams early so every new platform capability lands in the SDKs as an idiomatic, ergonomic feature on day one, and you'll drive the code generation, testing, and release pipeline that keeps seven languages consistent and shipping fast. You might be a good fit if you: Have a minimum of 8 years of practical full-stack engineering experience, ideally with 2+ years operating at a Staff or equivalent technical leadership level Have led the design and delivery of complex, developer-facing products across the full stack Are a technical expert in modern frontend and backend development, with demonstrated depth in key languages and frameworks (ie. React, Typescript) Take a product-focused approach to building solutions that are robust, scalable, and easy to use Have worked in early start-up or otherwise fast moving, rapidly evolving environments, and have ideally built products from 0 to 1 Care deeply in investing in the mentorship and growth of your peers Have successfully driven cross-team/cross-org organizational alignment to get impactful work shipped, and work with influence over authority Have experience establishing engineering standards, component architectures, and development best practices Thrive in fast-paced environments and can navigate ambiguity to deliver high-quality products Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Location Preference: Preference will be given to candidates based in NY or the Bay Area given the current location of team. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $405,000 — $485,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: AI Deployment Strategist, Critical and Sovereign Institutions - Paris
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ABOUT THE TEAM The Applied AI for Critical and Sovereign Institutions team is Mistral's specialized unit dedicated to delivering high-impact, secure AI solutions for institutions operating in highly regulated and strategic environments. We work hand-in-hand with clients to design, deploy, and maintain AI systems that meet the highest standards of reliability, security, and operational excellence, including on-premise, disconnected, and air-gapped deployments. As an AI Deployment Strategist on this team, you will drive the adoption and deployment of Mistral's AI solutions inside sovereign institutions and critical infrastructure, working closely with customers from strategic vision to production implementation. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, AI innovation, and hands-on deployment, under real operational, security, and compliance constraints. You will partner with senior leaders and mission owners to design AI roadmaps, collaborate with the Applied AI team to deliver solutions in production, and ensure seamless transitions from presales to postsales. Your work will directly contribute to projects with significant societal, operational, and strategic impact. WHAT YOU WILL DO Strategic Discovery & Vision Setting - Lead executive-level and mission-owner workshops to identify challenges and opportunities where Mistral's AI can drive step-change improvements in strategic environments. - Co-create AI adoption roadmaps with customers, articulating the "art of the possible" and a clear path to value within their regulatory and security perimeter. - Collaborate with Account Executives to develop business cases, quantify impact, and align solutions with mission and organizational objectives. AI Solution Design & Deployment - Architect end-to-end AI solutions, integrating Mistral's models and platform into customer workflows and secure technical infrastructure (cloud, on-premise, disconnected, air-gapped). - Partner with the Applied AI team to design, prototype, and deploy AI solutions in production, ensuring scalability, security, and impact. - Own the execution of pilots and proofs-of-value, demonstrating the potential of our technology and paving the way for full-scale deployment. Value Realization & Customer Success - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, guiding their AI strategy and ensuring they maximize the value of their investment in Mistral. - Monitor key performance indicators tied to operational and business outcomes, and communicate progress to executive sponsors. - Proactively identify expansion opportunities across use cases and units, building on initial successes to drive long-term partnerships. Cross-Functional Collaboration - Act as the bridge between customers and Mistral's internal teams, synthesizing feedback to influence product, science, and security roadmaps. - Develop reusable assets, best practices, and playbooks to scale go-to-market efforts and ensure consistent delivery excellence in regulated settings. - Travel (~30-60%) to foster deep client relationships and support on-site deployment. HOW WE WORK IN SOLUTIONS - We care about people and outputs. What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it. - Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week. - Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before. - We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care. - No politics. Low ego, high standards. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 2+ years in a client-facing strategic and technical role (e.g. data science consulting, value engineering, or technical sales). - A degree in a relevant scientific field (e.g. Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering). - Foundational knowledge of AI/ML/Data Science, with the credibility to advise both technical and non-technical audiences. - Hands-on experience building and deploying AI applications (Python, JavaScript, or similar) to demonstrate value. - Strong business acumen and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous challenges into actionable solutions. - Executive presence and communication skills to influence senior stakeholders (VP, C-level, mission owners). - Resilient, results-driven, and comfortable leading through influence in a collaborative environment. - Comfort operating under security, compliance, and confidentiality constraints. - Experience with sales qualification frameworks (e.g. MEDDPICC) and value-based selling is a plus. - Experience deploying AI in regulated or sovereign environments (defense, public sector, critical infrastructure) is a plus. SECURITY & COMPLIANCE CRITERIA - Eligibility: must hold citizenship in the target territory (France for now). - Clearable: must meet all local requirements for high-level security clearance (e.g. no criminal record, fulfillment of national service obligations). WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Senior Software Engineer, Enterprise Build
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Robinhood is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Enterprise Build team: the small, high-leverage team that turns the company's best AI-built prototypes into true enterprise-grade services. Robinhood has gone all-in on an AI-accelerated workforce: every week, Hoodies across Finance, HR, Legal, Compliance, and beyond use sanctioned AI tools to build working prototypes of the tools they wish they had. The best of those ideas deserve to become real software. That is this team's entire job, and yours. The team is built on the premise that AI multiplies what a senior engineer can own: agents do the first pass of assessment, porting, and scaffolding; you review, harden, and decide. The work is a distinctive loop. A prototype earns real usage in our experimental sandbox and arrives through a single front door. You assess it, decide what survives, often the idea and the workflow, rarely the code, and rebuild it as an enterprise-grade, production-spec service that meets our full engineering standards: SSO, audit logging, secrets management, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and security review, baked in from the first commit. While you build, you work directly with business partners, the forward-deployed pattern, pointed inward. Robinhood operates in a heavily regulated industry. Building fast here means building safely, and this team exists to help make sure those aren't in tension. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What You'll Do Assess vibe-coded prototypes from across the company and make the technical call: harden, rebuild, or redirect, then own the outcome end-to-end. Design, build, and ship services on Robinhood's enterprise platforms, meeting the company's full standards for secure, reliable enterprise software. Build AI-natively: drive agents through first-pass assessment, porting, and test scaffolding, and ship MCP servers, sub-agents, and agent skills as production artifacts where the solution calls for them. Work directly with sponsoring business units (Finance, HR, Legal, Compliance) during each build, translating real workflows into software people actually adopt. Deliver clean operational handoffs as part of your definition of done: runbooks, evals, and dashboards. Establish the paved patterns with the Enterprise Platforms team: when you solve the same problem twice, make it a platform capability the third time. Raise the bar on AI-era engineering quality, including rigorous, teaching-quality review of AI-generated code, your own and others'. What We're Looking For 5+ years of software engineering experience building and running production backend or full-stack systems, with a track record of independently delivering high-ambiguity projects end-to-end. Hands-on cloud depth, GCP preferred, including containerized services, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code, with a strong focus on a serverless stack. Demonstrated AI-native development: daily fluency with agentic coding tools, experience building LLM-powered applications or agentic workflows, and the judgment to review, harden, and productionize AI-generated code. Product sense and scoping discipline: you can find the 20% of a prototype worth keeping, say no to the rest, and finish, this team's leverage depends on engagements that end. Exceptional communication with non-engineers: you're comfortable embedded with finance, legal, or HR partners, translating in both directions without losing precision. Experience in highly regulated industries, particularly finance or fintech, is strongly preferred. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. items.title: Senior Media Planner, Strategy & Insights
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE The Growth team owns how Polymarket acquires users and converts attention into volume. We move fast, spend real money across a range of channels and geographies, and hold ourselves to business outcomes — not vanity metrics. The media investment function sits at the center of that, and right now it needs someone who can build the analytical backbone that makes every dollar accountable. This is not a coordination role. You will own the media plan, the forecast, the measurement approach, and the reconciliation. Polymarket operates in an event-driven, highly seasonal environment where timing and pricing can matter as much as budget size — we're looking for someone genuinely restless about finding edge, willing to go looking for the insight nobody asked for and kill their own conclusion when the data doesn't hold. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build the media plan across channels, categories, and geographies, and present a clear, defensible recommendation with tradeoffs and a point of view — not a menu of options - Own the forecasting layer covering spend, volume, acquisition cost, payback, and seasonality, and maintain scenario models that make tradeoffs legible before capital is committed; when we miss a forecast, explain why and make the next model better - Pace spend daily and weekly against approved allocations, flag over and under delivery early enough to act, and surface when the actual channel or geographic mix has drifted from the approved plan - Lead the measurement approach across mix modeling, incrementality testing, and geographic experiments, and synthesize the outputs into one defensible view of what is working rather than four competing ones - Reconcile every media dollar spent, tying platform spend to invoices, agency billing, and the finance ledger, and own accruals, credits, make-goods, and discrepancy resolution through monthly close - Hunt continuously for edge in auction dynamics, underpriced inventory, seasonality patterns, and competitive activity, and recommend in-flight reallocation with evidence when the data supports it - Build the reporting and analytics layer the team runs on, including dashboards, metric definitions, and a single source of truth that holds up under scrutiny from finance and leadership WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 6+ years in media planning, marketing analytics, or growth strategy with real ownership of plans and numbers — not just supporting roles - Deep fluency across paid channels including search, social, programmatic, video, audio, and offline, sufficient to pressure test a buyer's recommendation on the substance - Strong quantitative foundation in forecasting and scenario modeling; strong SQL and comfort in BI tooling — you build your own analysis rather than waiting for someone else to pull the data - Hands-on experience with mix modeling, incrementality testing, and geographic experiments, and the intellectual honesty to be clear about what each method can and cannot tell you - Financial rigor and comfort owning a number that has to tie out, including reconciliation, accruals, and working directly with finance through monthly close - Demonstrated ability to compress a complex analysis into a one-page recommendation an executive can act on in five minutes, with a track record of recommendations getting adopted because they are consistently well-built - Comfort being the person who says spend is off pace, and the follow-through to make sure it gets corrected without being told twice - (Plus) Background in trading, fintech, or event-driven demand businesses where unit economics and payback are scrutinized closely - (Plus) Experience building mix modeling in-house or managing a measurement vendor and holding them to a real standard - (Plus) Technical range in Python or R, or experience building your own analysis infrastructure - (Plus) Direct ownership of or meaningful contribution to a marketing P&L BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $210,000 to $240,000, plus equity and benefits. This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.

items.title: Senior Field Marketing Manager, Northern Europe
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ROLE SUMMARY As Senior Field Marketing Manager for the Northern Europe region, you will own and execute Mistral’s field marketing strategy, driving brand awareness, demand generation, and revenue growth. You’ll lead the end-to-end planning and delivery of external events, owned events, localized campaigns, ABM initiatives, and partner marketing activities. This role is ideal for a strategic thinker and hands-on project manager who excels in a collaborative, high-growth environment. Your work will directly advance our mission: delivering frontier AI to the world’s leading organizations to solve their toughest challenges. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Own the regional field marketing plan and budget for the Northern Europe region across the UK and the Nordics aligned to go-to-market objectives. - Partner with regional sales leadership to translate territory priorities and target accounts into field marketing programs. - Execute the plan of field programs from end-to-end across third-party conference sponsorships, Mistral-owned events (e.g., summits, roundtables, forums), account-Based Marketing (ABM) programs and campaigns. - Manage project timelines, vendor relationships, logistics, and speaker coordination with precision. - Allocate and optimize the regional marketing budget aligned with field marketing objectives. - Monitor and report on progress against objectives and the regional territory plan. Analyze campaign-level results, extract learnings, and iterate on strategies for continuous improvement. - Proactively engage with key stakeholders to ensure program success from sales, product marketing, demand gen, comms, public affairs. ABOUT YOU - 5+ years of experience in field marketing, with a focus on owned events, conference sponsorships, partner marketing, and ABM. - Enterprise B2B tech background, with a deep understanding of enterprise selling and B2B tech business models. - Proven experience managing field marketing programs in the Northern Europe region. - Strategic thinker and problem solver, able to translate business needs into actionable field marketing plans. - Strong project management skills, with the ability to deliver in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. - Fluent in English. - Self-starter mindset: Result-oriented, resourceful, innovative, and intellectually curious. - No ego, highly committed, with a growth mindset and the ability to quickly grasp complex topics. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Iepirkumu komandas vadītājs/ Procurement Manager
items.description: Iepirkumu komandas vadītājs ir atbildīgs par globālās iepirkumu stratēģijas izstrādi un ieviešanu, piegādātāju vadību, komerciālo sarunu veikšanu, kā arī noliktavas un loģistikas funkciju pārraudzību Property & Studio Development departamentā. Izstrādāt un īstenot globālo iepirkumu stratēģiju atbilstoši uzņēmuma un departamenta mērķiem; Vadīt RFQ, RFP un citus iepirkumu un tenderu procesus visās PSD lokācijās; Veikt komerciālās sarunas, slēgt ietvarlīgumus un stratēģiskos piegādātāju līgumus; Attīstīt un uzturēt ilgtermiņa sadarbību ar stratēģiski svarīgiem piegādātājiem; Uzraudzīt piegādātāju sniegumu, izmantojot KPI un pakalpojumu līmeņa vienošanās (SLA); Pārvaldīt iepirkumu līgumus sadarbībā ar juridisko komandu un citām iesaistītajām pusēm; Vadīt noliktavas un loģistikas procesus, nodrošinot inventāra precizitāti un efektīvu materiālu pieejamību; Izstrādāt un pārvaldīt iepirkumu budžetus, prognozes un izmaksu optimizācijas iniciatīvas; Nodrošināt atbilstību uzņēmuma politikām, normatīvajiem aktiem un audita prasībām; Sagatavot regulāras atskaites par iepirkumu izdevumiem, ietaupījumiem, piegādātāju sniegumu un riskiem; Vadīt, attīstīt un motivēt Iepirkumu, Noliktavas un Loģistikas komandas; Veicināt procesu uzlabošanu, digitalizāciju un labākās iepirkumu prakses ieviešanu. The Procurement Manager is responsible for developing and implementing the global procurement strategy, managing supplier relationships, leading commercial negotiations, and overseeing warehouse and logistics operations within the Property & Studio Development Department. Develop and implement the global procurement strategy in line with company and departmental objectives; Lead RFQ, RFP, tendering, and sourcing processes across all PSD locations; Negotiate commercial agreements, framework contracts, and strategic supplier partnerships; Develop and maintain long-term relationships with key suppliers; Monitor supplier performance through KPIs and service level agreements (SLAs); Manage procurement contracts in cooperation with Legal and other stakeholders; Oversee warehouse and logistics operations, ensuring inventory accuracy and efficient material availability; Develop and manage procurement budgets, forecasts, and cost optimization initiatives; Ensure compliance with company policies, regulations, and audit requirements; Prepare regular reports on procurement spend, savings, supplier performance, and risks; Lead, develop, and motivate Procurement, Warehouse, and Logistics teams; Drive continuous improvement, digitalisation, and procurement best practices. Prasības: Vismaz 7 gadu pieredze iepirkumu, piegādes ķēdes, sourcing vai komerciālās vadības jomā, tai skaitā vismaz 3 gadu pieredze vadošā amatā; Augstākā izglītība iepirkumu, piegādes ķēdes vadības, biznesa vadības, finanšu, tiesību, inženierzinātņu vai saistītā jomā; Starptautiski atzīta profesionālā kvalifikācija (piemēram, CIPS, CPSM) tiks uzskatīta par priekšrocību; Pieredze iepirkumu stratēģiju izstrādē un ieviešanā starptautiskās organizācijās; Pieredze piegādātāju pārvaldībā, tenderu procesos un līgumu slēgšanā; Spēcīga komerciālā domāšana un spēja analizēt izmaksas, riskus un biznesa ieguvumus; Pieredze budžetu plānošanā, izmaksu optimizācijā un finanšu analīzē; Pieredze komandu vadībā un starpfunkcionālā sadarbībā; Teicamas pārrunu vadīšanas un ietekmēšanas prasmes; Analītiska domāšana un uz datiem balstīta lēmumu pieņemšana; Pieredze darbā ar ERP sistēmām (Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, Oracle vai līdzvērtīgām); Padziļinātas MS Excel prasmes un pieredze darbā ar atskaitēm un analītiku; Teicamas angļu valodas zināšanas rakstiski un mutiski - darbam ar uzņēmuma iekšējām sistēmām un ikdienas saziņai ar citiem starptautiskajiem departamentiem; Pieredze darbā starptautiskā un multikulturālā vidē; Augsta atbildības sajūta, integritāte un profesionālā ētika. Qualifications: Minimum 7 years of experience in procurement, sourcing, supply chain, or commercial management, including at least 3 years in a leadership role; University degree in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, Law, Engineering, or a related field; Professional certification such as CIPS, CPSM, or equivalent will be considered an advantage; Proven experience developing and implementing procurement strategies within multinational organizations; Strong experience in supplier management, tendering, and contract negotiations; Strong commercial acumen with the ability to assess costs, risks, and business value; Experience in budgeting, cost optimisation, and financial analysis; Experience leading teams and collaborating across functions; Excellent negotiation and influencing skills; Strong analytical skills and data-driven decision-making capabilities; Experience working with ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, Oracle, or equivalent; Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience with reporting and analytics; Excellent written and spoken English - to work with the company's internal systems and daily communicate with other international departments; Experience working in an international and multicultural environment; High level of integrity, accountability, and professional ethics.

items.title: Tehniskais spēļu mākslinieks(-ce) /Technical Game Artist
items.description: Mēs meklējam talantīgu un proaktīvu Tehnisko spēļu mākslinieku, kurš pievienosies mūsu komandai. Šajā lomā Tu būsi svarīgs savienojums starp mākslas, dizaina un izstrādes komandām, nodrošinot gan radošus, gan tehniski kvalitatīvus rezultātus. Nodrošināt tehnisko atbalstu dizaina komandai, palīdzot risināt tehniski sarežģītus uzdevumus un darbā ar programmatūru un rīkiem, tostarp strādājot ar spēles kodu/Blueprints; Nodrošināt praktisku atbalstu māksliniekiem un inženieriem aktīvu veiktspējas un validācijas jautājumos, kā arī palīdzēt risināt spēles problēmas un kļūdas; Izstrādāt un ieviest mākslas nodaļas procesu automatizāciju; Veidot spēles aktīvus un vidi pēc pieprasījuma (spēt palīdzēt Game Artist kolēģiem viņu uzdevumos noslodzes gadījumos); Zināšanas rakstzīmju animācijā (spēja rediģēt un attīrīt animācijas); Izstrādāt un uzturēt tehnisko dokumentāciju komandas vajadzībām; Sekot līdzi aktuālajām un nākotnes tendencēm grafikas programmatūrā un aparatūrā; Sadarboties ar iekšējām komandām, lai radītu idejas uzlabojumiem un priekšlikumiem; Sadarboties ar izstrādātājiem, dizaina komandu un iesaistītajām pusēm; Uzturēt projektus un darba failus, kā arī skaidri komunicēt izpildes termiņus; Piedalīties dizaina pārskatēs, komandas sanāksmēs un ideju ģenerēšanas sesijās. We are looking for a talented and proactive Technical Game Artist to join our team. In this role, you will act as a key link between art, design, and development teams, ensuring both creative and technically high-quality results. Provide technical support to the design team, assisting with complex technical tasks and working with software and tools, including game code/Blueprints; Provide hands-on support to artists and engineers in asset performance and validation, and help resolve in-game issues and bugs; Develop and implement automation processes within the art department; Create game assets and environments on request, supporting Game Artists during peak workload periods; Apply character animation knowledge, including editing and cleaning animations; Develop and maintain technical documentation for team use; Stay up to date with current and emerging trends in graphics software and hardware; Work with internal teams to generate ideas for improvements and proposals; Collaborate with developers, the design team, and stakeholders; Maintain project files and ensure clear communication of delivery timelines; Participate in design reviews, team meetings, and brainstorming sessions. Prasības: Vidējā speciālā vai augstākā izglītība; Angļu valoda vismaz B2 līmenī (mutiski un rakstiski) darba pienākumu veikšanai - darbam ar uzņēmuma iekšējām sistēmām un ikdienas saziņai ar citiem starptautiskajiem departamentiem; Vismaz 3 gadu pieredze spēļu izstrādē; Zināšanas C++, Python vai MAXScript; Pieredze ar versiju kontroles sistēmām (Git, Perforce); Pieredze ar 3D rīkiem (3ds Max, Maya, Blender u.c.); Labas Unreal Engine zināšanas (Niagara – priekšrocība); Pieredze ar daļiņu sistēmām; Pamatzināšanas Adobe rīkos (Photoshop, Substance); Labas komunikācijas, analītiskās un problēmu risināšanas prasmes; Spēja strādāt ar vairākiem uzdevumiem, ievērot termiņus un veidot dokumentāciju; Spēja strādāt patstāvīgi un komandā; Spēja skaidri komunicēt idejas starp komandām. Būs priekšrocība: Izglītība dizainā, multimedijos vai līdzīgā jomā; Pieredze ar citiem spēļu dzinējiem; Zināšanas ZBrush vai līdzīgos rīkos; Pieredze ar renderēšanas rīkiem (piem., Corona); Spēcīgas skriptēšanas prasmes (C++, Python, MAXScript); Izpratne par WebGL; Pieredze ar AI rīkiem vai LLM; Pieredze iGaming nozarē. Requirements: Secondary specialised or higher education; English proficiency B2+ (spoken & written) for performing job duties – working with the company's internal systems and daily communication with other international departments; 3+ years of experience in game development; Knowledge of C++, Python, or MAXScript; Experience with version control (Git, Perforce); Familiarity with 3D tools (3ds Max, Maya, Blender, etc.); Good knowledge of Unreal Engine (Niagara is a plus); Experience with particle systems; Basic knowledge of Adobe tools (Photoshop, Substance); Strong communication, problem-solving, and attention to detail; Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and create technical documentation; Ability to work both independently and in a team; Ability to communicate ideas clearly across teams. Nice to have: Degree in design, multimedia, or similar; Experience with other game engines; Knowledge of ZBrush or similar tools; Experience with offline renderers (e.g., Corona); Strong scripting skills (C++, Python, MAXScript); Understanding of WebGL; Experience with AI tools, neural networks, or LLMs; Experience in the iGaming industry.

items.title: Senior AI Engineer
items.description: We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our Data Center of Excellence ( CoE ) team at Betsson Group. You'll design, build, and deploy AI and agentic solutions with real business impact, from LLM-driven pipelines to intelligent automation, while helping shape our technical direction. If you're passionate about applied AI and enjoy turning emerging research into production-grade systems, we'd love to hear from you! The Wow You'll be at the forefront of AI innovation in iGaming - a space where cutting-edge technology meets real-time, high-stakes decision-making. As part of our Data CoE , you'll take ownership of complex AI initiatives end-to-end, from architecture to deployment, working closely with stakeholders to translate business needs into production-grade solutions. You'll have the autonomy to solve hard problems independently, the platform to influence how AI is adopted across the business, and the opportunity to share your expertise with the wider team. A taster of what you will be involved with: Expect to independently design, build, and deploy LLM-powered pipelines and autonomous agents that solve real operational challenges from intelligent automation to advanced retrieval systems. You'll work closely with stakeholders to scope and deliver solutions, get hands-on with frameworks like LangChain , and help set best practices around MLOps and production-grade AI. You'll also have opportunities to mentor developers and contribute to internal knowledge-sharing as part of a well-rounded senior role. What we are looking for: The ideal candidate must have the following: BSc/MSc in CS, AI/ML, Data Science, or related field 3+ years industry experience designing, building and deploying Generative AI solutions Strong proficiency in Python Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, Strands or equivalent) Solid foundations in deep learning and foundation models Experience integrating and orchestrating LLM-based pipelines end-to-end Ability to lead technical discussions, mentor junior/mid developers, and deliver internal knowledge sessions Familiarity with LLMOps (CI/CD pipelines, model hosting, evaluation, production monitoring) Good knowledge of RAG pipelines The following are preferred but not required : Familiarity with cloud AI services (AWS Bedrock, Azure Open AI) Experience with fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA) Experience in building advanced knowledge retrieval systems including Knowledge Graphs and Context Graphs Previous experience in iGaming industry What we offer Much like riding a rollercoaster, sometimes life at Betsson can be lightning fast with twists and turns but always FUN! Then again, what else would you expect from a business 75% millennial and 1700 strong, spread across 7 offices with 900 based out of our Malta HQ alone! We recognise it may not be for the faint-hearted, but if you’re a go-getter, initiator and adrenaline junkie, always striving to push the boundaries and challenge yourself, then you’ll fit right in. Challenge accepted? By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our Privacy Policy

items.title: Account Director, Startups (Mandarin-Speaking)
items.description: About the team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure artificial general intelligence (AGI) benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one organization. In pursuit of this mission, our Go-To-Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team includes Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnerships professionals who work together to create valuable solutions that help bring AI to as many users as possible. About the role OpenAI is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Account Director to join our Startup Go-To-Market team. You will play a critical role in owning relationships with top startup customers and supporting them in successfully building on the OpenAI platform. Many of the most disruptive and category-defining AI applications are being created by startups. The Startup Go-To-Market team's mission is to help startups harness the power of OpenAI’s technology to drive these advances. You will support startups in building effectively with OpenAI’s APIs, SDKs, and applications while providing access to OpenAI’s technical expertise and networks to help accelerate their progress. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and strategy. You’ll be responsible for serving as the primary relationship owner for a range of strategically important startup customers. You’ll also work cross-functionally with product, research, engineering, support, and technical solutions teams to help customers get the most out of our models. This role will be based in Singapore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. In this role, you'll: - Manage a portfolio of startup accounts, developing and executing strategies for comprehensive account management. - Partner with AI Deployment Engineers to drive successful technical engagements with startups. - Own consumption and contracted revenue targets while managing revenue forecasts. - Analyze key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders. - Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering teams. - Serve as an advocate for improving the startup experience of building with OpenAI, synthesizing product feedback from insights gathered through our work with startups. - Closely monitor the industry and startup landscapes and contribute to corporate strategy. - Support the recruitment and onboarding of teammates. - Support the development of company culture. We're seeking someone with experience including: - 7–12 years of experience selling platform-as-a-service (PaaS), cloud, or other API products. - Experience working in or around the startup ecosystem, preferably as a startup founder, startup employee, or someone who has worked closely with startup customers. - Supporting the growth and product development of fast-growing, high-performing companies. - Working directly with C-level executives and startup founders. - Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders. - Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market intelligence across industries, competitors, customers, and prospects. - The ability to speak Mandarin, as you will be working with Mandarin-speaking customers You might thrive in this role if you: - Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customers’ priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor. - Have a passion for or deep curiosity about artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in ways that benefit humanity. You’re excited to educate customers on AI and help them plan for the future. - Are a builder. You are excited to influence how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision. - Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them energizes you. You enjoy tackling bespoke issues that require multidimensional thinking and are willing to experiment with new solutions. - Are a strategist. You deeply understand go-to-market best practices and continually raise the bar for our organization. You think and plan years ahead and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link https://form.asana.com/?k=bQ7w9h3iexRlicUdWRiwvg&d=57018692298241. OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy https://cdn.openai.com/policies/global-employee-and-contractor-privacy-policy.pdf At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

items.title: 专业交易产品负责人
items.description: 【岗位职责】 1、全面负责专业交易平台的产品规划、路线图设计、版本迭代和落地质量。 2、深入研究专业交易员、资深交易用户及机构/半机构用户的交易流程，抽象核心需求并转化为产品方案。 3、负责专业 K 线、行情展示、下单面板、订单管理、持仓管理、选择交易、多腿交易等核心模块设计。 4、对标主流专业版及传统金融交易终端，持续提升产品专业度和易用性。 5、与研发、设计、交易系统、风控、运营等团队协作，推动复杂交易场景高质量交付。 6、建立并跟踪产品指标，关注专业用户留存、交易转化、使用深度、交易效率和用户满意度。 6、对交易链路的效率、安全感、稳定性、信息密度和专业用户体验负责，持续打磨产品细节。 【任职要求】 1、5 年以上产品经验，有专业交易终端、行情软件、券商、期货、外汇、衍生品、金融交易平台等相关产品经验。 2、具备较深交易理解，熟悉专业交易用户的实际工作流，包括看盘、分析、下单、盯仓、止盈止损、订单管理等场景。 3、熟悉 K 线、盘口、订单簿、限价单、市价单、条件单、止盈止损、持仓、成交、资金等基础交易能力。 4、有复杂 Web 工具型产品经验，能处理高信息密度、高交互频率、高稳定性要求的产品场景。 5、具备较强产品判断力，能够识别专业用户真实痛点，而不是简单复制竞品功能。 6、具备产品负责人意识，能独立制定方向、拆解路径、推动跨团队协作，并对最终产品结果负责。 7、具备优秀的 PRD、交互方案、需求优先级判断、AI使用能力和项目推进能力。 【加分项】 1、做过聚合交易、跨所交易、多腿交易、策略交易、专业 K 线、行情系统或量化辅助工具。 2、自己有股票、期货、外汇、期权或其他衍生品交易经验，深度使用各类交易终端产品 3、有国际化交易产品经验，理解不同市场交易用户的使用习惯。 4、对交易系统、撮合、风控、行情延迟、订单状态流转等底层机制有一定理解。

items.title: 交易引擎核心开发
items.description: 【公司简介】 我们是全球最早也是最成熟的数字资产平台之一，服务于全球数千万用户。我们始终位列全球Top交易所之列，提供涵盖数千种数字资产的全面交易和财富管理产品。我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中蓬勃发展的优秀人才。 【岗位职责】 1、核心研发：研发和优化核心交易组件，包括撮合模块、订单处理、订单簿数据结构和低延迟服务链路。 2、高并发与性能调优：深入代码逻辑、内存管理、并发模型（线程/协程）、网络 IO 及操作系统行为，攻克高吞吐与极低延迟场景下的性能瓶颈。 3、高可用与稳定性：落地与完善高可用机制，保障系统在极端行情、硬件故障下的故障切换、恢复、降级及业务连续性。 4、提升工程质量，完善测试、可观测性、日志、指标、链路追踪、文档和故障复盘机制。 【任职要求】 1、5 年以上后端经验（技术栈不限），且近几年专注于高并发高可用的核心系统 2、精通 Linux 网络编程（Socket、TCP/IP或异步 IO 模型），深入理解多线程/多进程/协程并发编程与内存模型 3、能精准定位并解决内存布局/垃圾回收（GC）、CPU Cache、网络路径及系统限制带来的性能瓶颈 4、在突发故障或极端行情高压下保持冷静，具备严谨的排障思路、谨慎的发布习惯与完善的可观测性意识 【加分项】 1、业务背景：有撮合引擎、订单簿、行情系统、券商系统、高频交易（HFT）开发经验 1、熟悉无锁（Lock-Free）结构、NUMA 架构、用户态网络栈（DPDK/Kernel Bypass）或硬件加速。

items.title: AI Agent 产品专家（C 端金融）
items.description: 【公司简介】 我们是全球最早也是最成熟的数字资产平台之一，服务于全球数千万用户。我们始终位列全球Top交易所之列，提供涵盖数千种数字资产的全面交易和财富管理产品。我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中蓬勃发展的优秀人才。 【关于岗位】 1、AI 到底如何帮助金融实现业务增长？这是目前全球金融行业都在探索、但尚无成熟范式可循的难题。 2、我们不想做一个挂在 App 首页、回答泛泛问题的 Chatbot。这个岗位的核心使命是：站在交易用户的视角，探索 AI Agent 如何重构用户的行情理解、交易决策与风险管理链路，并为平台带来可衡量的业务增量（激活、留存与交易转化）。 3、你不会接手一个既定的需求列表，而是需要独立拆题、提出假设、设计 MVP 并拿到成果。 【岗位职责】 1、C 端场景拆题与增长探索：深入用户在交易链路中的决策痛点，识别高价值 Agent 场景（如行情辅助、决策支持、策略解释、风险提醒和资产复盘），验证 AI 对业务增长的实际 ROI。 2、设计高信任度的 Agent 交互：解决 AI 幻觉在金融严肃场景下的痛点，在智能引导、风险提示、合规边界和用户自主决策之间找到平衡。 3、主导Agent产品闭环：定义产品形态、核心假设、MVP 范围与验证指标，联动算法、工程、风控及运营团队，推动上线并用业务数据复盘价值。 4、建立交易级 Agent 评测标准：针对金融场景建立评测体系（关注意图识别准确率、工具调用、事实准确性、安全兜底及业务转化效果）。 【任职要求】 1、大厂 / 主流 AI 公司背景：有一线大厂、头部 AI 公司或成熟 AI 产品团队经验，完整主导过面向真实用户的 AI Agent、AI 助手或 AI 原生产品。 2、金融 / 交易场景深度理解：有金融交易、投资、券商、行情、财富管理相关产品经验，理解交易用户的真实心理与决策痛点。 3、C 端业务与增长敏锐度：具备强增长视角，能从用户激活、留存、交易转化和信任建立的角度设计 AI 产品，拒绝“为了 AI 而 AI”。 4、能在高度不确定的环境中独立拆题、验证方向、推动上线，并用数据复盘产品价值。 【加分项】 1、有创业、早期团队或 0 到 1 商业化项目经验 2、是交易、投资的深度用户
